title: Random small-room mazes (e.g. Thornwold's Split Beech/Deer Break/Black Thorn Stand cluster, Wardmoor's Peat Score/Tower Rise cluster) had many directionally identical-looking exits, causing repeated backtracking loops even with the free 'get bearings' action, since bearings often didn't list the specific landmark being sought until much closer to it.
